findings.title: Output dir created before dirty-tree validation leaves partial output
findings.message: The output directory is created with out.mkdir() before the clean-tree check, so a dirty tree raises ValueError after the directory already exists. Re-running with the same path then fails, which undermines the 'exclusive fresh output' flow. On any later failure the partial output is also left behind.
findings.suggestion: Run the git revision and dirty checks before out.mkdir(), and remove the partial output directory on failure.

findings.title: Mesh-growth check shares exhausted deadline and baseline is stale
findings.message: The baseline is captured before the orbit, pan, zoom and add. If the buffer allocation counter is incremented by non-growth events, or if the add does not trigger a reallocation (capacity slack), the check fails or passes for the wrong reason. The smoke could time out spuriously because the shared 40s deadline is partly consumed by the readiness loop.
findings.suggestion: Use a fresh deadline for the second wait and capture the baseline immediately before m.add(), so the check is tied to the growth event.
